verdict.rationale: Capacities is object-type-first with custom object types and typed properties that can be defined and auto-filled (via AI), consistent tagging, and these properties/tags are used for retrieval through search, graph view, backlinks, and exported as structured front matter/CSV for programmatic reuse. Community feedback corroborates tagging and entity organization as a core differentiator versus tools like Notion. missing for 10: no hands-on power-user account of large-scale consistency enforcement (e.g., property validation/constraints across many objects), and no independent review specifically testing retrieval accuracy at scale.
